15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 1 ADMINISTRATION,105  RULES OF ETHICS,105.8, ,sub-sec-15.1.6.8,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5193,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.1.6.8,False,0,"105.8 A member of the Board shall disqualify himself or herself in a proceeding before the Board in which the Board member’s impartiality might reasonably be questioned, including but not limited to instances where:

column2: or (d) The member of the Board or their spouse, domestic partner, parent, or child wherever residing, or any other member of the Board member’s family residing in the Board member’s household:

(2) Is acting as a lawyer or otherwise representing a party in the proceeding
column2: or (3) Is known to have a more than de minimus interest that could be substantially affected by the proceeding."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,401  EXPEDITED REVIEW,401.11, ,sub-sec-15.4.2.11,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5338,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.2.11,False,0,"401.11 Orders granting an application approved by expedited review need not contain findings of facts or conclusions of law, but shall reflect the nature of the relief granted and any conditions imposed."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,402  PUBLIC NOTICE REQUIREMENTS,402.1, ,sub-sec-15.4.3.1,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5340,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.3.1,False,0,"402.1 Not less than forty
(40) days before the public hearing on an application, the Director shall give notice of public hearing by:
(a) Publishing the notice of public hearing in the D.C. Register
(b) Providing a copy of the notice of public hearing to the applicant
(c) Providing a copy of the notice of public hearing to the affected ANC, and for any other ANC that is within two hundred feet (200 ft.) of the property involved in the application
(d) Providing a copy of the notice of public hearing to the owners of all property within two hundred feet (200 ft.) of the subject property
column2: provided, however, that in the case of a residential condominium or cooperative with twenty-five

column1: (25) or more dwelling units, mailed notice may be provided to the board of directors of the association of the condominium or cooperative that represents all of the owners of the dwelling units
(e) Providing a copy of the notice of public hearing to each person having a lease with the owner for all or part of any building located on the subject property
(f) Providing a copy of the notice of public hearing to the Office of Planning and all other appropriate government agencies
(g) Providing a copy of the notice of public hearing to the Councilmember for the ward within which the property is located
column2: and (h) Posting in the Office of Zoning the schedule of cases to be heard by the Board on the public hearing date."

column1: 15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,402  PUBLIC NOTICE REQUIREMENTS,402.2, ,sub-sec-15.4.3.2,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5341,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.3.2,False,0,"402.2 The notice of public hearing on an application shall include:
(a) The case number of the application
(b) The name of the applicant
(c) The citation to the legal authority pursuant to which the application has been filed
(d) The nature of the proposed zoning relief
(e) The square(s) and lot(s) and/or street address of the property involved
(f) The location, date, and time of the public hearing
(g) The number of the affected ANC
column2: and (h) In the case of a special exception or variance application, the requirements for participation as a party."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,402  PUBLIC NOTICE REQUIREMENTS,402.11, ,sub-sec-15.4.3.11,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5350,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.3.11,False,0,"402.11 If the Board finds a failure or defect in the notice of public hearing, the Board shall determine whether to postpone, continue, or hold the public hearing as scheduled based on the following considerations:

column1: 15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,403  PARTIES: GENERAL GUIDELINES,403.1, ,sub-sec-15.4.4.1,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5352,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.4.1,False,0,"403.1 This section and Subtitle Y

These provisions do not apply to chancery applications, which are rulemaking proceedings and therefore no parties are allowed."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,403  PARTIES: GENERAL GUIDELINES,403.2, ,sub-sec-15.4.4.2,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5353,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.4.2,False,0,403.2 The use of the term “person” includes entities.

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,403  PARTIES: GENERAL GUIDELINES,403.3, ,sub-sec-15.4.4.3,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5354,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.4.3,False,0,"403.3 All persons may present testimony before the Board, but parties may also present witnesses, cross-examine witnesses, file pleadings and proposed orders, receive pleadings and proposed orders filed by other parties, and receive the final order issued by the Board."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,403  PARTIES: GENERAL GUIDELINES,403.4, ,sub-sec-15.4.4.4,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5355,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.4.4,False,0,403.4 Being a party is not a prerequisite to filing a petition to review a Board decision with the District of Columbia Court of Appeals.

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,403  PARTIES: GENERAL GUIDELINES,403.5, ,sub-sec-15.4.4.5,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5356,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.4.5,False,0,"403.5 The following persons automatically have party status:
(a) The applicant
column2: and (b) The affected ANC
column3: except that if the subject property is located on a street that serves as a boundary line between two ANC’s, both ANCs are automatic parties."

column1: 15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,403  PARTIES: GENERAL GUIDELINES,403.6, ,sub-sec-15.4.4.6,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5357,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.4.6,False,0,"403.6 In a variance or special exception proceeding before the Board, a party shall be afforded all the procedural rights provided in this subtitle, including the right to receive a copy of any:
(a) Service by any other party in the case of documents at the same time or before the document is filed with the Board
column2: and (b) Written notice of any decision or order entered in the case."

column1: 15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,403  PARTIES: GENERAL GUIDELINES,403.7, ,sub-sec-15.4.4.7,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5358,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.4.7,False,0,"403.7 In all variance or special exception proceedings before the Board, a party may:
(a) Submit motions and requests to the Board, and respond to any motions or requests submitted to the Board by others
(b) Present witnesses in support of the party’s position
(c) Cross-examine all other parties and persons testifying in the case
(d) Submit proposed findings of fact and conclusions of law
column2: and (e) Exercise all other procedural rights provided in this subtitle."

column1: 15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,403  PARTIES: GENERAL GUIDELINES,403.8, ,sub-sec-15.4.4.8,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5359,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.4.8,False,0,"403.8 In a chancery proceeding before the Board, no person shall have the standing of a party."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,404  REQUESTING PARTY STATUS,404.1, ,sub-sec-15.4.5.1,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5361,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.5.1,False,0,"404.1 Except for the Applicant and the affected ANC, to participate as a party in a proceeding before the Board, any affected person shall file with the Board a Request for Party Status on the form and in the manner that the Director may prescribe.
The person requesting party status and their authorized representatives, if any, shall provide the following information in their initial filing with the Board:
(a) Name, mailing address, telephone number, and e-mail address
(b) An identification of the application by number, the applicant’s name, and the address of the property that is the subject of the application
(c) A request to appear and participate as a party
(d) Whether the person will appear as a proponent or opponent of the application
(e) If the person will appear through legal counsel or other authorized representation and, if so, the name and address of the legal counsel or other authorized representation
(f) If the person will be represented by an individual, the request shall contain a written authorization that includes the power of the representative to bind the person in the case before the Board

(g) If the party status request is not being made by an individual, but by an association, corporation, partnership, government agency, or other similar entity, the request shall include proof that the entity authorized the persons filing the request to do so.
The proof may consist of a resolution of the person’s board of directors
column2: a copy of the by-law provision authorizing the particular officer, employee, or agent to represent the person in such proceedings
column3: a letter signed by all the members of the organization
column4: or similar proof satisfactory to the Board

column1: (h) A list of witnesses who will testify on the person's behalf, a written summary of the testimony of all witnesses, and a complete and professional resume for any expert who may be called to testify at the public hearing
column2: and (i) A written statement setting forth why the person should be granted party status, including reference to the following:

column1: (1) The property owned or occupied by the person, or in which the person has an interest, that will be affected by the action requested of the Board
(2) The legal interest the person has in the property, such as owner, tenant, trustee, or mortgagee
(3) The distance between the person's property and the property that is the subject of the application before the Board
(4) The environmental, economic, social, or other impacts likely to affect the person and/or the person's property if the action requested of the Board is approved or denied
column2: and

column1: (5) An explanation of how the person's interests as identified in response to paragraph
(4) would likely be more significantly, distinctively, or uniquely affected in character or kind by the proposed zoning action than those of other persons in the general public."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,404  REQUESTING PARTY STATUS,404.2, ,sub-sec-15.4.5.2,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5362,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.5.2,False,0,"404.2 The Board shall determine whether to grant or deny party status requests at the opening of the first public hearing on the application except the Board may consider a party status request at a public meeting scheduled at least fourteen

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,404  REQUESTING PARTY STATUS,404.3, ,sub-sec-15.4.5.3,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5363,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.5.3,False,0,"404.3 A Request for Party Status that is to be considered at a public hearing shall be filed with the Board not less than fourteen
(14) days prior to the public hearing."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,404  REQUESTING PARTY STATUS,404.4, ,sub-sec-15.4.5.4,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5364,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.5.4,False,0,"404.4 A Request for Party Status that is requested to be considered at a public meeting shall identify the public meeting date sought and shall be filed with the Board not less than fourteen
(14) days prior to that date."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,404  REQUESTING PARTY STATUS,404.5, ,sub-sec-15.4.5.5,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5365,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.5.5,False,0,"404.5 If there is no public meeting scheduled within thirty
(30) days of the public hearing, the person may request that the Chairperson schedule a special public meeting to hear the party status request."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,404  REQUESTING PARTY STATUS,404.6, ,sub-sec-15.4.5.6,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5366,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.5.6,False,0,"404.6 At or before the time of filing the request, the person requesting party status shall serve a copy of the request on the applicant and the affected ANC."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,404  REQUESTING PARTY STATUS,404.7, ,sub-sec-15.4.5.7,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5367,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.5.7,False,0,"404.7 At the time of the filing request, the person requesting party status shall file an affidavit of service to all parties with the Board."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,404  REQUESTING PARTY STATUS,404.8, ,sub-sec-15.4.5.8,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5368,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.5.8,False,0,"404.8 Any opposition to a party status request by the applicant or affected ANC shall be filed within seven
(7) days following the date by which it was served.
An applicant’s or affected ANC’s failure to file a timely opposition shall be deemed signifying no objection to the Request for Party Status."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,404  REQUESTING PARTY STATUS,404.9, ,sub-sec-15.4.5.9,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5369,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.5.9,False,0,404.9 Replies to any opposition by the person requesting party status will not be accepted into the record.

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,404  REQUESTING PARTY STATUS,404.10, ,sub-sec-15.4.5.10,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5370,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.5.10,False,0,"404.10 A person requesting party status must be present at the public hearing or meeting at which the request is being considered
column2: however, the attendance of the applicant or affected ANC at the public meeting is discretionary.

column1: Failure of the person or their representative to appear shall be deemed to constitute the withdrawal of the party status request."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,404  REQUESTING PARTY STATUS,404.11, ,sub-sec-15.4.5.11,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5371,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.5.11,False,0,"404.11 During the portion of a public meeting in which a party status request is being considered, the Board may call forward the person making the request as well as the Applicant or affected ANC if an objection was timely made pursuant to Subtitle Y
§ 404.8. The Board may put questions to the person making the request and the Applicant or affected ANC and to hear argument on the issue."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,404  REQUESTING PARTY STATUS,404.12, ,sub-sec-15.4.5.12,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5372,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.5.12,False,0,"404.12 The Board shall determine who will be recognized as a party.
In so determining, the Board shall consider whether the provisions of Subtitle Y
§ 404.1 have been complied with and whether the specific information presented qualifies the person as a party."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,404  REQUESTING PARTY STATUS,404.13, ,sub-sec-15.4.5.13,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5373,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.5.13,False,0,"404.13 The Board shall grant party status only if the person requesting party status has clearly demonstrated that the person's interests would likely be more significantly, distinctively, or uniquely affected in character or kind by the proposed zoning action than those of other persons in the general public."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,404  REQUESTING PARTY STATUS,404.14, ,sub-sec-15.4.5.14,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5374,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.5.14,False,0,404.14 No person may request reconsideration of the denial of their party status request.

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,404  REQUESTING PARTY STATUS,404.15, ,sub-sec-15.4.5.15,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5375,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.5.15,False,0,"404.15 If a Request for Party Status is denied, another Request for Party Status may not be made."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,404  REQUESTING PARTY STATUS,404.16, ,sub-sec-15.4.5.16,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5376,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.5.16,False,0,"404.16 If a person granted party status no longer wishes to participate in the application, the person or their representative shall file written notice of that intent, which shall be served on the other parties.

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,405  REFERRALS TO AND REPORTS OF PUBLIC AGENCIES,405.1, ,sub-sec-15.4.6.1,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5378,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.6.1,False,0,"405.1 The provisions of this section apply as follows:
(a) This section except for Subtitle Y

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: APPLICATIONS,408  HEARING PROCEDURES: GENERAL PROVISIONS,408.1, ,sub-sec-15.4.9.1,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5398,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.4.9.1,False,0,"408.1 The presiding officer at a public hearing on an application shall have the authority to:

(f) Adjourn a public hearing and establish the date when the public hearing will be continued

(h) Take action to maintain decorum and order
column2: and (i) Take any other action authorized by or necessary under this subtitle."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 5 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: ZONING APPEALS,501  INTERVENOR STATUS: GENERAL GUIDELINES,501.1, ,sub-sec-15.5.2.1,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5426,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.5.2.1,False,0,"501.1 In a zoning appeal, the following persons automatically have party status:
(a) The appellant
(b) The person whose administrative decision is the subject of the appeal, the appellee

column1: 15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 5 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: ZONING APPEALS,501  INTERVENOR STATUS: GENERAL GUIDELINES,501.2, ,sub-sec-15.5.2.2,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5427,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.5.2.2,False,0,"501.2 In a civil infraction appeal, only the persons who participated as parties in the proceeding below shall have party status:
(a) The appellant
(b) The District of Columbia Department of Consumer and Regulatory Affairs
column2: and (c) Any person who participated as a party in the proceeding that is the subject of the order being appealed."

column1: 15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 5 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: ZONING APPEALS,501  INTERVENOR STATUS: GENERAL GUIDELINES,501.3, ,sub-sec-15.5.2.3,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5428,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.5.2.3,False,0,"501.3 Any person may move to intervene in a zoning appeal and may become an intervenor thereto if the Board finds that the party has an interest that may not be adequately represented by the automatic parties
column2: provided, that the intervention would not unduly broaden the issues or delay the proceedings."

column1: 15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 5 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: ZONING APPEALS,501  INTERVENOR STATUS: GENERAL GUIDELINES,501.4, ,sub-sec-15.5.2.4,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5429,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.5.2.4,False,0,"501.4 In an appeal proceeding before the Board, an intervenor shall be afforded all the procedural rights provided in this subtitle, including the right to receive a copy of any:
(a) Documents filed by any other party in the case at the same time or before the document is filed with the Board
column2: and (b) Written notice of any decision or order entered in the case."

column1: 15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 5 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: ZONING APPEALS,501  INTERVENOR STATUS: GENERAL GUIDELINES,501.5, ,sub-sec-15.5.2.5,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5430,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.5.2.5,False,0,"501.5 In all contested case proceedings before the Board, an intervenor may:

column2: and (e) Exercise all other procedural rights provided in this subtitle."

column1: 15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 5 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: ZONING APPEALS,502  REQUESTING INTERVENOR STATUS,502.1, ,sub-sec-15.5.3.1,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5432,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.5.3.1,False,0,"502.1 Those persons who do not have automatic party status in a zoning appeal pursuant to Subtitle Y

§ 501.1, but who wish to participate as an intervenor in a contested case proceeding before the Board, shall file a written request for intervenor status with the Board that meets the following requirements:
(a) The person requesting intervenor status and their authorized representatives, if any, shall provide the following information in their initial filing with the Board:
Name, mailing address, telephone number, facsimile number, and e-mail address
(b) An identification of the appeal by number, the appellant’s name, and the address of the property that is the subject of the appeal
(c) A request to appear and participate as an intervenor
(d) Whether the person will appear as a proponent or opponent of the appeal
(e) If the person will appear through legal counsel or other authorized representation and, if so, the name and address of the legal counsel or other authorized representation
(f) If the person will be represented by an individual, the request shall contain a written authorization that includes the power of the representative to bind the person in the case before the Board

(g) If the intervenor status request is not being made by an individual, but by an association, corporation, partnership, government agency, or other similar entity, the request shall include proof that the entity authorized the persons filing the request to do so.
The proof may consist of a resolution of the person’s board of directors
column2: a copy of the by-law provision authorizing the particular officer, employee, or agent to represent the person in such proceedings
column3: a letter signed by all the members of the organization
column4: or similar proof satisfactory to the Board

column1: (h) A list of witnesses who will testify on the person's behalf
column2: and (i) A written statement setting forth why the person should be granted intervenor status, including reference to the following:

column1: (1) The property owned or occupied by the person, or in which the person has an interest, that will be affected by the action requested of the Board
(2) The legal interest the person has in the property, such as owner, tenant, trustee, or mortgagee
(3) The distance between the person's property and the property that is the subject of the application before the Board
(4) The environmental, economic, social, or other impacts likely to affect the person and/or the person's property if the appeal is affirmed or reversed
column2: and

column1: (5) An explanation of how the party has an interest that may not be adequately represented by the automatic parties."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 5 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: ZONING APPEALS,502  REQUESTING INTERVENOR STATUS,502.6, ,sub-sec-15.5.3.6,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5437,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.5.3.6,False,0,"502.6 At or before the time of filing the request, the person requesting intervenor status shall serve a copy of the request on the appellant and the affected ANC."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 5 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: ZONING APPEALS,502  REQUESTING INTERVENOR STATUS,502.7, ,sub-sec-15.5.3.7,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5438,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.5.3.7,False,0,"502.7 At the time of filing the request, the person requesting intervenor status shall file an affidavit of service to all parties with the Board."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 5 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: ZONING APPEALS,502  REQUESTING INTERVENOR STATUS,502.8, ,sub-sec-15.5.3.8,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5439,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.5.3.8,False,0,"502.8 Any opposition to an intervenor status request by the appellant or affected ANC shall be filed within seven

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 5 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: ZONING APPEALS,502  REQUESTING INTERVENOR STATUS,502.12, ,sub-sec-15.5.3.12,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5443,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.5.3.12,False,0,"502.12 The Board shall determine who will be recognized as an intervenor.

column2: and"

(d) Rule upon offers of proof and receive relevant evidence

column2: and (h) Take any other action authorized by or necessary under this subtitle."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 5 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: ZONING APPEALS,507  HEARING PROCEDURES: ZONING APPEALS,507.1, ,sub-sec-15.5.8.1,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5472,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.5.8.1,False,0,"507.1 The order for presenting evidence and arguments at the public hearing on a zoning appeal shall be as follows:

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,600  DISPOSITION OF CASE BY WITHDRAWAL OR DISMISSAL,600.1, ,sub-sec-15.6.1.1,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5481,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.6.1.1,False,0,600.1 This section applies to all applications and appeals.

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,600  DISPOSITION OF CASE BY WITHDRAWAL OR DISMISSAL,600.2, ,sub-sec-15.6.1.2,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5482,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.6.1.2,False,0,"600.2 An applicant or appellant may withdraw, respectively, an application or appeal at any time prior to the issuance of the Board’s written final decision and order, subject to the following conditions:
(a) The applicant or appellant shall file a written statement with the Board withdrawing the application or appeal
(b) Withdrawal shall not authorize the removal of any document from the files of the Board
(c) The application or appeal fee shall not be refunded upon withdrawal
(d) If an application is withdrawn before the close of the record, a new application or appeal shall not be accepted for filing for at least ninety
(90) days after the date the written statement of withdrawal is filed
(e) If an application is withdrawn after the close of the record, a new application or appeal shall not be accepted for filing for at least one
(1) year after the date the written statement of withdrawal is filed

(f) The Board will grant permission to file a new application after a shortened time period only upon motion and for good cause shown, provided the shortened time period will not prejudice the rights of any person
column2: and (g) A withdrawn appeal may not be re-filed."

column1: 15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,600  DISPOSITION OF CASE BY WITHDRAWAL OR DISMISSAL,600.3, ,sub-sec-15.6.1.3,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5483,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.6.1.3,False,0,"600.3 The Board may dismiss an application or appeal for failure of the applicant or appellant to comply with the procedural requirements of this subtitle, as follows:
(a) Dismissal shall not authorize the removal of any document or paper from the files of the Board
(b) The application or appeal fee shall not be refunded upon dismissal
(c) If an application is dismissed before the close of the record, a new application or appeal shall not be accepted for at least ninety
(90) days after the date of the written order dismissing the application or appeal
(d) If an application or appeal is dismissed after the close of the record, a new application shall not be accepted for filing for at least one
(1) year after the date of the written order dismissing the application or appeal

(e) The Board will grant permission to file a new application after a shortened time period only upon motion and for good cause shown, provided the shortened time period will not prejudice the rights of any person
column2: and (f) A dismissed appeal may not be re-filed."

column1: 15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,600  DISPOSITION OF CASE BY WITHDRAWAL OR DISMISSAL,600.4, ,sub-sec-15.6.1.4,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5484,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.6.1.4,False,0,"600.4 No application or appeal shall be dismissed on the grounds that the applicant or appellant failed to comply with the provisions of this subtitle unless, after due notice of the deficiency and expiration of a reasonable time as fixed by the Board, the deficiency has not been corrected, except that the Board may immediately dismiss an application or appeal if the applicant or appellant fails to appear at a hearing without explanation."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,602  CLOSING THE RECORD,602.1, ,sub-sec-15.6.3.1,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5491,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.6.3.1,False,0,"602.1 The record shall be closed following the public hearing, except that the record may be kept open for a stated period for the receipt of specific exhibits, information, or legal briefs, as may be directed by the presiding officer."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,602  CLOSING THE RECORD,602.2, ,sub-sec-15.6.3.2,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5492,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.6.3.2,False,0,"602.2 Each party shall serve any specific exhibits, information, or legal briefs on all other parties at the same time as specific exhibits, information, or legal briefs are filed with the Board."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,602  CLOSING THE RECORD,602.3, ,sub-sec-15.6.3.3,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5493,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.6.3.3,False,0,"602.3 The Board shall allow all parties to a case an opportunity to file written responses to any exhibits, information, or briefs submitted after the close of the hearing.

(7) days after the date by which the exhibits, information, or briefs were due, unless otherwise directed by the presiding officer.
Replies by other parties to the aforementioned responses will not be accepted into the record."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,602  CLOSING THE RECORD,602.4, ,sub-sec-15.6.3.4,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5494,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.6.3.4,False,0,602.4 The Board may on its own motion reopen the record prior to making a final decision for the purposes of requesting additional submissions or conducting a further hearing on designated issues.

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,602  CLOSING THE RECORD,602.5, ,sub-sec-15.6.3.5,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5495,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.6.3.5,False,0,"602.5 Notice of any further hearing need only be provided to the parties.
Notice of the reopened record and any further hearing, plus a designation of the issues, shall be forwarded to any party who appeared and participated in the earlier hearings.
If only additional submissions are requested, the notice shall identify which parties are required to make the submission which parties may reply, and the time period for doing so.
If a further hearing is to be held, the notice of such hearing shall be sent at least ten
(10) days prior to the date set for the further hearing."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,602  CLOSING THE RECORD,602.6, ,sub-sec-15.6.3.6,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5496,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.6.3.6,False,0,"602.6 Any supplemental material received by the Board after the close of the record that bears upon the substance of the application or appeal shall be returned by the Director and not accepted into the files of the Board.
However, if the materials are accompanied by a separate request to reopen the record, the request shall be accepted and presented to the Board for consideration.
The request must demonstrate good cause and the lack of prejudice to any party.
Such requests may be granted by the presiding officer and, if granted, the supplemental materials shall be entered into the record."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,602  CLOSING THE RECORD,602.7, ,sub-sec-15.6.3.7,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5497,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.6.3.7,False,0,"602.7 The Director shall notify the parties by e-mail of the acceptance of supplemental material.

(7) days after the date of the e-mail notice."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,604  FINAL DECISION AND EFFECTIVE DATE OF DECISIONS,604.4, ,sub-sec-15.6.5.4,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5504,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.6.5.4,False,0,"604.4 The prevailing party in any application or appeal may file a proposed order or a revision to a previously filed proposed order after a vote to approve or deny the application or affirm or reverse a decision is taken.

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,604  FINAL DECISION AND EFFECTIVE DATE OF DECISIONS,604.5, ,sub-sec-15.6.5.5,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5505,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.6.5.5,False,0,"604.5 Formal notice of an order shall be given to any party to the application, by serving the party with a copy of the final order."

column1: ORDER",700.2, ,sub-sec-15.7.1.2,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5518,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.7.1.2,False,0,"700.2 Any party may file a motion for reconsideration or rehearing of any decision of the Board granting or denying an application or appeal, provided that the motion is filed with the Director within ten
(10) days from the date of issuance of a final written order by the Board.

A request by a non-party for leave to file a motion for reconsideration shall not be accepted."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 7 APPROVALS AND ORDERS,701  STAY OF FINAL DECISION AND ORDER,701.1, ,sub-sec-15.7.2.1,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5531,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.7.2.1,False,0,"701.1 The provisions of this section apply as follows:
(a) This section applies in its entirety to zoning appeals and variance and special exception applications
(b) Except with respect to a stay pending rehearing, the provisions of this section apply to civil infraction appeals
column2: and (c) This section shall not apply to chancery proceedings."

column1: 15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 7 APPROVALS AND ORDERS,701  STAY OF FINAL DECISION AND ORDER,701.2, ,sub-sec-15.7.2.2,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5532,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.7.2.2,False,0,"701.2 The Board, on its own motion or the motion of a party or petitioner to the District of Columbia Court of Appeals, may order the effectiveness of a final decision and order of the Board stayed pending reconsideration or rehearing, or appeal of the decision and order to the Court of Appeals."

15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 7 APPROVALS AND ORDERS,701  STAY OF FINAL DECISION AND ORDER,701.3, ,sub-sec-15.7.2.3,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5533,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.7.2.3,False,0,"701.3 Except for stays granted upon its own motion, the Board shall grant a stay only upon finding that all four of the following criteria are present:

(a) The party seeking the stay (or, in the case of a stay to be issued on the Board’s own motion, the party in whose favor the stay would be ordered) is likely to prevail on the merits of the motion for reconsideration or rehearing, the sua sponte review, or the appeal
(b) Irreparable injury will result if the stay is denied
(c) Opposing parties will not be harmed by a stay
column2: and (d) The public interest favors the granting of the stay."

column1: 15,SUBTITLE Y BOARD OF ZONING ADJUSTMENT RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 7 APPROVALS AND ORDERS,701  STAY OF FINAL DECISION AND ORDER,701.4, ,sub-sec-15.7.2.4,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5131#secid-5534,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_15#15.7.2.4,False,0,"701.4 In determining whether to grant a stay, the Board may consider the following factors:
(a) Whether the party filing the motion is likely to succeed on the merits
(b) Whether denial of the stay will cause irreparable injury
(c) Whether, and to what degree, granting the stay will harm other parties
column2: and (d) Whether the public interest favors granting a stay."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 1 ADMINISTRATION,105  RULES OF ETHICS,105.8, ,sub-sec-16.1.6.8,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5671,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.1.6.8,False,0,"105.8 A member of the Commission shall disqualify himself or herself in a proceeding before the Commission in which the member’s impartiality might reasonably be questioned, including but not limited to instances where:

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,402  PUBLIC NOTICE REQUIREMENTS,402.1, ,sub-sec-16.4.3.1,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5833,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.3.1,False,0,"402.1 Not less than forty
(40) days before the public hearing on an application, the Director shall give notice of public hearing by:

(b) Providing a copy of the notice of public hearing to the applicant
(c) Providing a copy of the notice of public hearing to the affected ANC and to any other ANC that is within two hundred feet (200 ft.) of the property involved in the application
(d) Providing a copy of the notice of public hearing to owners of all property within two hundred feet (200 ft.) of the property included in the application
column2: provided, however, in the case of a residential condominium or cooperative with twenty-five

column1: (25) or more dwelling units, notice may be provided to the board of directors or to the association of the condominium or cooperative that represents all of the owners of all such dwelling units
(e) Providing a copy of the notice of the public hearing to each person having a lease with the owner for all or part of any building located on the subject property

column2: and (h) Posting a copy of the notice of the public hearing on the Office of Zoning’s website."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,402  PUBLIC NOTICE REQUIREMENTS,402.12, ,sub-sec-16.4.3.12,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5844,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.3.12,False,0,"402.12 A technical defect in the notice of public hearing that is minor in nature shall not deprive the Commission of jurisdiction over the case.

column1: 16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,403  PARTIES: GENERAL GUIDELINES,403.1, ,sub-sec-16.4.4.1,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5846,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.4.1,False,0,"403.1 This section and Subtitle Z

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,403  PARTIES: GENERAL GUIDELINES,403.2, ,sub-sec-16.4.4.2,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5847,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.4.2,False,0,403.2 The use of the term “person” includes entities.

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,403  PARTIES: GENERAL GUIDELINES,403.3, ,sub-sec-16.4.4.3,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5848,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.4.3,False,0,"403.3 All persons may present testimony before the Commission, but parties may also present witnesses, cross-examine witnesses, file pleadings and proposed orders, receive pleadings and proposed orders filed by other parties, and receive the final order issued by the Commission."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,403  PARTIES: GENERAL GUIDELINES,403.4, ,sub-sec-16.4.4.4,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5849,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.4.4,False,0,403.4 Being a party is not a pre-requisite to filing a petition to review a Commission decision with the District of Columbia Court of Appeals.

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,403  PARTIES: GENERAL GUIDELINES,403.5, ,sub-sec-16.4.4.5,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5850,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.4.5,False,0,"403.5 In an application for a contested case before the Commission, including, but not limited to, cases described in Subtitle Z
§ 201.2, the following persons automatically have party status:
(a) The applicant
column2: and (b) The ANC within which the property that is the subject of the application is located
column3: except that if the subject property is located on a street that serves as a boundary line between two

column1: (2) ANC’s, both ANCs are automatic parties."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,403  PARTIES: GENERAL GUIDELINES,403.6, ,sub-sec-16.4.4.6,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5851,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.4.6,False,0,"403.6 In a contested case proceeding before the Commission, a party shall be afforded all the procedural rights provided in this chapter, including the right to receive a copy of any:
(a) Service by any other party in the case of documents at the same time or before the document is filed with the Commission
column2: and (b) Written notice of any decision or order entered in the case."

column1: 16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,403  PARTIES: GENERAL GUIDELINES,403.7, ,sub-sec-16.4.4.7,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5852,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.4.7,False,0,"403.7 In all contested case proceedings before the Commission, a party may:
(a) Submit motions and requests to the Commission, and respond to any motions or requests submitted to the Commission by others
column2: provided that the record is open

column1: (b) Present witnesses in support of the party’s position
(c) Cross-examine all other parties and persons testifying in the case
(d) Submit proposed findings of fact and conclusions of law
column2: and (e) Exercise all other procedural rights provided in this chapter."

column1: 16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,404  REQUESTING PARTY STATUS,404.1, ,sub-sec-16.4.5.1,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5854,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.5.1,False,0,"404.1 Except for the applicant and the affected ANC, to participate as a party in a proceeding before the Commission, a person seeking such status shall file with the Commission a Request for Party Status on the form and in the manner that the Director may prescribe.
The person requesting party status and their authorized representatives, if any, shall provide the following information in their initial filing with the Commission:
(a) Name, mailing address, telephone number, and e-mail address
(b) An identification of the application by number, the applicant’s name, and the address of the property that is the subject of the application
(c) A request to appear and participate as a party
(d) Whether the person will appear as a proponent or opponent of the application
(e) If the person will appear through legal counsel or other authorized representation and, if so, the name and address of the legal counsel or other authorized representation
(f) If the person requesting party status is not an individual, the following shall be provided:
(1) Evidence that the entity requesting party status has authorized the entity’s participation in the proceeding
column2: and

column1: (2) Evidence that the entity requesting party status has designated a specific officer, employee, or agent to act on its behalf and bind entity in the proceeding

(g) A list of witnesses who will testify on the person's behalf, a written summary of the testimony of all witnesses, and a complete and professional resume for any expert who may be called to testify at the public hearing
column2: and (h) A written statement setting forth why the person should be granted party status, including reference to the following:

column1: (1) The property owned or occupied by the person, or in which the person has an interest, that will be affected by the action requested of the Commission
(2) The legal interest the person has in the property, such as owner, tenant, trustee, or mortgagee
(3) The distance between the person's property and the property that is the subject of the application before the Commission
(4) The environmental, economic, social, or other impacts likely to affect the person and/or the person's property if the action requested of the Commission is approved or denied
column2: and

column1: (5) An explanation of how the person's interests as identified in response to paragraph
(4) would likely be more significantly, distinctively, or uniquely affected in character or kind by the proposed zoning action than those of other persons in the general public."

§ 404.1(f) may consist of a resolution of the person’s board of directors
column2: a copy of the by-laws provision authorizing the particular officer, employee, or agent to represent the person in such proceedings
column3: a letter signed by all the members
column4: or similar proof satisfactory to the Commission."

column1: 16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,404  REQUESTING PARTY STATUS,404.3, ,sub-sec-16.4.5.3,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5856,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.5.3,False,0,"404.3 The Commission shall determine whether to grant or deny party status requests at the opening of the first public hearing on the application, except the Commission may consider a party status request at a public meeting scheduled at least fourteen

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,404  REQUESTING PARTY STATUS,404.4, ,sub-sec-16.4.5.4,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5857,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.5.4,False,0,"404.4 A Request for Party Status that is to be considered at a public hearing shall be filed with the Commission not less than fourteen

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,404  REQUESTING PARTY STATUS,404.6, ,sub-sec-16.4.5.6,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5859,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.5.6,False,0,"404.6 If there is no public meeting scheduled within thirty

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,404  REQUESTING PARTY STATUS,404.7, ,sub-sec-16.4.5.7,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5860,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.5.7,False,0,"404.7 At or before the time of filing the request, the person requesting party status shall serve a copy of the request on the applicant and the affected ANC."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,404  REQUESTING PARTY STATUS,404.8, ,sub-sec-16.4.5.8,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5861,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.5.8,False,0,"404.8 At the time of the filing request, the person requesting party status shall file an affidavit of service to all parties with the Commission
column2: 16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,404  REQUESTING PARTY STATUS,404.9, ,sub-sec-16.4.5.9,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5862,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.5.9,False,0,404.9 Any opposition to a party status request by the applicant or affected ANC shall be filed within seven

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,404  REQUESTING PARTY STATUS,404.11, ,sub-sec-16.4.5.11,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5864,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.5.11,False,0,"404.11 A person requesting party status must be present at the public hearing or meeting at which the request is being considered

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,404  REQUESTING PARTY STATUS,404.12, ,sub-sec-16.4.5.12,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5865,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.5.12,False,0,"404.12 During the portion of a public meeting in which a party status request is being considered, the Commission may call forward the person making the request, as well as the applicant or affected ANC, if an objection was made timely pursuant to Subtitle Z

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,404  REQUESTING PARTY STATUS,404.13, ,sub-sec-16.4.5.13,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5866,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.5.13,False,0,"404.13 The Commission shall determine who will be recognized as a party.

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,407  MOTIONS PROCEDURE,407.5, ,sub-sec-16.4.8.5,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5890,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.8.5,False,0,407.5 The presiding officer may decide any procedural motion including motions to continue without holding a hearing.

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,408  PUBLIC HEARING PROCEDURES,408.1, ,sub-sec-16.4.9.1,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5892,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.9.1,False,0,"408.1 The presiding officer shall have authority to:
(a) Call the hearing to order
(b) Consider preliminary matters, including, but not limited to, party status requests, motions, and qualifying expert witnesses
(c) Conduct the hearing
(d) Rule upon offers of proof and receive relevant evidence
(e) Exclude unduly repetitious or irrelevant testimony, and permit a witness to adopt the prior testimony of another witness
(f) Adjourn a hearing and establish the date when the hearing will be continued
(g) Close the hearing and record
(h) Take action to maintain decorum and order
column2: and (i) Take any other action authorized by this title or necessary under this chapter."

column1: 16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,408  PUBLIC HEARING PROCEDURES,408.2, ,sub-sec-16.4.9.2,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5893,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.9.2,False,0,"408.2 Except as provided in Subtitle Z
§ 408.4, the applicant and all parties (except an affected ANC) in support shall collectively have a maximum of sixty
(60) minutes, exclusive of cross-examination, to present testimony.

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,408  PUBLIC HEARING PROCEDURES,408.4, ,sub-sec-16.4.9.4,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5895,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.9.4,False,0,"408.4 The Commission may grant additional or lesser time than that allowed under Subtitle Z

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,408  PUBLIC HEARING PROCEDURES,408.5, ,sub-sec-16.4.9.5,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5896,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.9.5,False,0,"408.5 Nothing herein shall prohibit the Commission from placing reasonable restrictions on cross-examination, including limitations on the scope of cross-examination, by the applicant or parties in support or opposition."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,408  PUBLIC HEARING PROCEDURES,408.6, ,sub-sec-16.4.9.6,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5897,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.9.6,False,0,"408.6 A party may cross-examine any other party, individual, or organization representative, except the Commission
column2: provided, that the presiding officer may rule a question out of order when it is irrelevant, immaterial, or unduly repetitious, or otherwise outside of the scope of cross-examination."

column1: 16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,408  PUBLIC HEARING PROCEDURES,408.7, ,sub-sec-16.4.9.7,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5898,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.9.7,False,0,"408.7 Evidence shall be taken in conformity with D.C. Official Code § 2-509(b) (2012 Repl.).
Pursuant to D.C. Official Code § 2-509(b) (2012 Repl.
), any oral and any documentary evidence may be received, but the Commission shall exclude irrelevant, immaterial, and unduly repetitious evidence.

Every party shall have the right to present in person or by counsel its case or defense by oral and documentary evidence, to submit rebuttal evidence, and to conduct such cross-examination as may be required for a full and true disclosure of the facts.

Where any decision of the Commission in a contested case rests on official notice of a material fact not appearing in the evidence in the record, any party to such case shall on timely request be afforded an opportunity to show the contrary."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,408  PUBLIC HEARING PROCEDURES,408.8, ,sub-sec-16.4.9.8,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5899,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.9.8,False,0,"408.8 The applicant shall carry the burden of justifying the proposal.
Failure of groups or persons to appear in opposition shall not relieve the applicant of the responsibility of demonstrating the merits of the application.

The applicant shall advise the Zoning Commission of the efforts that have been made to apprise the affected Advisory Neighborhood Commission and other individuals and community groups concerning the proposed development."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,408  PUBLIC HEARING PROCEDURES,408.9, ,sub-sec-16.4.9.9,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5900,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.9.9,False,0,"408.9 The order of procedure for presenting evidence at the hearing shall be as follows:
(a) Call to order and opening statement by the presiding officer
(b) Consideration of preliminary matters, including, but not limited to, party status requests, motions, and qualifying expert witnesses
(c) Applicant's case
(d) Reports or statements by the Office of Planning (OP) and other government agency representatives, if any
(e) Affected ANC(s)
(f) Parties in support of the application
(g) Individuals and organization representatives in support of the application
(h) Parties in opposition to the application
(i) Individuals and organization representatives in opposition to the application
(j) Individuals and organization representatives who are undeclared with respect to the application
(k) Rebuttal by applicant
column2: and (l) Closing statement by applicant."

column1: 16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,408  PUBLIC HEARING PROCEDURES,408.10, ,sub-sec-16.4.9.10,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5901,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.9.10,False,0,"408.10 If surprise to the applicant or to a party in a contested case is clearly shown and the inability to proceed is demonstrated, a hearing may be adjourned to allow the applicant or party sufficient time to offer rebuttal evidence.
This evidence shall be filed with the Director at least fourteen
(14) days before the hearing is resumed."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 4 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: CONTESTED CASES,408  PUBLIC HEARING PROCEDURES,408.11, ,sub-sec-16.4.9.11,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5902,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.4.9.11,False,0,"408.11 The Commission may close the record at the end of a hearing and vote either to deny an application or to grant an application not involving a map amendment or schedule the case for final action at a public meeting.

If the application is for a map amendment, including a map amendment proposed in association with a planned unit development, the Commission may deny the application, take proposed action on the application, or schedule the application for proposed action at a public meeting."

CASE PETITIONS FOR HEARING",500.2, ,sub-sec-16.5.1.2,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5908,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.5.1.2,False,0,"500.2 The Director shall review for completeness every petition filed with the Commission within five
(5) days after its receipt.
Upon completing the review of a petition, the Director shall notify the petitioner in writing of any deficiency.
The notice shall list the information necessary to make the petition complete and the date the information must be received, which shall not be less than five

(b) The date the public meeting of the ANC to consider the petition occurred
(c) A statement that proper notice of that public meeting was given by the ANC
(d) The number of members of the ANC that constitute a quorum and the number of members present at the public meeting
(e) The issues and concerns of the ANC about the petition, as related to the standards against which the petition shall be judged
(f) The recommendation, if any, of the ANC as to the disposition of the petition
(g) The outcome of the vote on the motion to adopt the report to the Commission
(h) The name of the person who is authorized by the ANC to present the report
column2: and (i) The signature of the ANC chairperson or vice-chairperson."

REPORT",505.2, ,sub-sec-16.5.6.2,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5949,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.5.6.2,False,0,"505.2 The oral testimony of the ANC representative shall not be given great weight, unless accompanied within seven
