16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 5 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: RULEMAKING CASES,506  PUBLIC HEARING PROCEDURES,506.1, ,sub-sec-16.5.7.1,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5951,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.5.7.1,False,0,"506.1 Any individual or organization representative may appear at a hearing in a rulemaking case proceeding, and may present, within the time limits determined by the Commission, evidence, testimony, or argument that is relevant and not unduly repetitious pursuant to Subtitle Z

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 5 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: RULEMAKING CASES,506  PUBLIC HEARING PROCEDURES,506.2, ,sub-sec-16.5.7.2,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5952,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.5.7.2,False,0,506.2 There are no parties in a rulemaking case proceeding.

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 5 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: RULEMAKING CASES,506  PUBLIC HEARING PROCEDURES,506.3, ,sub-sec-16.5.7.3,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5953,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.5.7.3,False,0,"506.3 The presiding officer shall have authority to:
(a) Call the hearing to order
(b) Consider preliminary matters, including, but not limited to, motions, and qualifying expert witnesses
(c) Conduct the hearing
(d) Rule upon offers of proof and receive relevant evidence
(e) Exclude unduly repetitious or irrelevant testimony, and permit a witness to adopt the prior testimony of another witness
(f) Adjourn a hearing and establish the date when the hearing will be continued
(g) Close the hearing and record
(h) Take action to maintain decorum and order
column2: and (i) Take any other action authorized by this title or necessary under this subtitle."

column1: 16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 5 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: RULEMAKING CASES,506  PUBLIC HEARING PROCEDURES,506.4, ,sub-sec-16.5.7.4,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5954,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.5.7.4,False,0,"506.4 The order for presenting evidence and arguments at the public hearing for a rulemaking case proceeding shall be as follows:
(a) Call to order and opening statement by the presiding officer
(b) Consideration of preliminary matters, including, but not limited to, motions and qualifying expert witnesses
(c) Petitioner’s case
(d) Reports or statements by the Office of Planning and other government agency representatives, as needed
(e) Affected ANC(s)
(f) Individuals and organization representatives in support of the petition
(g) Individuals and organization representatives in opposition to the petition
column2: and (h) Individuals and organization representatives who are undeclared with respect to the petition."

column1: 16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 5 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: RULEMAKING CASES,506  PUBLIC HEARING PROCEDURES,506.5, ,sub-sec-16.5.7.5,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5955,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.5.7.5,False,0,"506.5 The Commission may close the record at the end of a hearing and vote either to deny the petition or take proposed action to grant the petition.
Alternatively, the Commission may schedule the case for proposed action at a public meeting."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 5 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: RULEMAKING CASES,506  PUBLIC HEARING PROCEDURES,506.6, ,sub-sec-16.5.7.6,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5956,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.5.7.6,False,0,506.6 No decision or order of the Commission on a petition shall be made except upon the exclusive record of the proceedings before the Commission.

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 5 PRE-HEARING AND HEARING PROCEDURES: RULEMAKING CASES,506  PUBLIC HEARING PROCEDURES,506.7, ,sub-sec-16.5.7.7,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5957,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.5.7.7,False,0,506.7 All testimony shall be provided under oath or affirmation.

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,600  DISPOSITION OF CASE BY WITHDRAWAL OR DISMISSAL,600.1, ,sub-sec-16.6.1.1,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5960,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.1.1,False,0,600.1 An applicant or petitioner may withdraw an application or petition at any time prior to advertisement of the hearing.

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,600  DISPOSITION OF CASE BY WITHDRAWAL OR DISMISSAL,600.2, ,sub-sec-16.6.1.2,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5961,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.1.2,False,0,"600.2 Following advertisement, an application or petition may be withdrawn only with the consent of the Commission."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,600  DISPOSITION OF CASE BY WITHDRAWAL OR DISMISSAL,600.3, ,sub-sec-16.6.1.3,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5962,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.1.3,False,0,"600.3 An applicant or petitioner may withdraw, respectively, an application or petition at any time prior to the issuance of the Commission’s written final decision and order, subject to the following conditions:
(a) The applicant or petitioner shall file a written statement with the Commission withdrawing the application or petition
(b) Withdrawal shall not authorize the removal of any document or paper from the files of the Commission
(c) The application or petition fee shall not be refunded upon withdrawal
column2: and (d) If an application or petition is withdrawn, a new application or petition shall not be accepted for filing for at least ninety

column1: (90) days after the date the written statement of withdrawal is filed."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,600  DISPOSITION OF CASE BY WITHDRAWAL OR DISMISSAL,600.4, ,sub-sec-16.6.1.4,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5963,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.1.4,False,0,"600.4 The Commission may dismiss an application or petition for failure of the applicant or petitioner to comply with the procedural requirements of this chapter, as follows:
(a) Dismissal shall not authorize the removal of any document or paper from the files of the Commission
(b) The application or petition fee shall not be refunded upon dismissal
column2: and (c) If an application or petition is dismissed before the close of the record, a new application or petition shall not be accepted for at least ninety

column1: (90) days after the date of the written order dismissing the application or petition."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,600  DISPOSITION OF CASE BY WITHDRAWAL OR DISMISSAL,600.5, ,sub-sec-16.6.1.5,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5964,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.1.5,False,0,"600.5 No application or petition shall be dismissed on the grounds that the applicant or petitioner failed to comply with the provisions of this chapter unless, after due notice of the deficiency and expiration of a reasonable time as fixed by the Commission, the deficiency has not been corrected."
16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,"601  PROPOSED FINDINGS OF FACT AND CONCLUSIONS OF

LAW",601.1, ,sub-sec-16.6.2.1,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5966,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.2.1,False,0,"601.1 In a contested case, the applicant is required to submit proposed findings of fact and conclusions of law to the Office of Zoning within such time as the presiding officer may direct, which in any event shall not be less than seven
(7) days after the transcript of the public hearing is delivered to OZ, pursuant to Subtitle Z
§ 104.4. However, nothing prevents an applicant from submitting proposed findings of facts and conclusions of law earlier if it chooses to do so."
16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,"601  PROPOSED FINDINGS OF FACT AND CONCLUSIONS OF

LAW",601.2, ,sub-sec-16.6.2.2,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5967,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.2.2,False,0,"601.2 In a contested case, other parties who choose to submit findings of fact and conclusions of law shall do so in accordance with Subtitle Z
16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,"601  PROPOSED FINDINGS OF FACT AND CONCLUSIONS OF

LAW",601.3, ,sub-sec-16.6.2.3,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5968,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.2.3,False,0,"601.3 Each party shall serve any proposed findings of fact and conclusions of law on all other parties at the same time or before the proposed findings and conclusions are filed with the Commission.
The parties shall also file a certificate of service."
16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,"601  PROPOSED FINDINGS OF FACT AND CONCLUSIONS OF

LAW",601.4, ,sub-sec-16.6.2.4,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5969,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.2.4,False,0,"601.4 If requested by the Commission, the applicant or other parties may submit revised findings of facts and conclusions of law, provided that no such filing may be made later than seven
(7) days prior to the date the application is scheduled for final action."
16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,"601  PROPOSED FINDINGS OF FACT AND CONCLUSIONS OF

LAW",601.5, ,sub-sec-16.6.2.5,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5970,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.2.5,False,0,"601.5 Unless the Commission specifies otherwise in a proceeding, no responses shall be permitted to a party’s proposed findings of fact and conclusions of law."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,602  CLOSING THE RECORD,602.1, ,sub-sec-16.6.3.1,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5972,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.3.1,False,0,"602.1 The record shall be closed at the end of the public hearing, unless the Commission makes a determination to keep the record open for a stated period for the receipt of specific exhibits, information, or legal briefs, as directed by the presiding officer."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,602  CLOSING THE RECORD,602.2, ,sub-sec-16.6.3.2,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5973,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.3.2,False,0,"602.2 In a contested case, an applicant that has been required by Subtitle Z

§ 401.2 to submit a memorandum of understanding, and who did not submit, during or before the hearing, a fully executed written agreement to implement that memorandum, shall submit a written agreement, executed by the applicant and all appropriate agencies or entities, prior to the scheduling of proposed action."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,602  CLOSING THE RECORD,602.3, ,sub-sec-16.6.3.3,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5974,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.3.3,False,0,"602.3 In a contested case, the Commission shall allow all parties to a case an opportunity to file written responses to any exhibits, information, or legal briefs submitted after the close of the public hearing.
All responses shall be filed within seven
(7) days following the date by which the exhibits, information, or legal briefs were due.
Replies by other parties to the aforementioned responses will not be accepted into the record."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,602  CLOSING THE RECORD,602.4, ,sub-sec-16.6.3.4,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5975,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.3.4,False,0,"602.4 In a rulemaking case, the Commission may allow individuals an opportunity to file written responses to any exhibits, information, or legal briefs submitted within the period designated by the Commission."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,602  CLOSING THE RECORD,602.5, ,sub-sec-16.6.3.5,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5976,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.3.5,False,0,"602.5 Prior to taking final action in a contested case, the Commission may on its own motion re-open the record and require submission of additional materials or further hearing on designated issues before the Commission.
Notice of a further hearing along with a designation of issues shall be forwarded to any party who participated in the earlier proceedings, or the party's authorized representative.
Notice shall be given at least fourteen
(14) days prior to the date set for further hearing."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,602  CLOSING THE RECORD,602.6, ,sub-sec-16.6.3.6,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5977,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.3.6,False,0,"602.6 Any supplemental material received by the Commission after the close of the record that bears upon the substance of the application or petition shall be returned by the Director and not accepted into the files of the Commission.
However, if the materials are accompanied by a separate request to re-open the record, the request shall be accepted and presented to the Commission for consideration.
The request must demonstrate good cause and the lack of prejudice to any party.
Such requests may be granted by the presiding officer and, if granted, the supplemental materials shall be entered into the record."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,603  PROPOSED ACTION,603.1, ,sub-sec-16.6.4.1,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5979,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.4.1,False,0,"603.1 As used in this section, proposed action means a vote taken after a hearing by the Commission to:
(a) Publish a Notice of Proposed Rulemaking in the D.C. Register to permanently amend the zoning map or the text of the zoning regulations
column2: or (b) Refer the following types of cases to the National Capital Planning Commission (NCPC) for comment and review:

column1: (1) Proposals to permanently amend the text of this title other than Subtitles A, Y, or Z or the zoning map
column2: and

column1: (2) Applications to grant a map amendment including an application related to a planned unit development application."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,603  PROPOSED ACTION,603.2, ,sub-sec-16.6.4.2,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5980,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.4.2,False,0,"603.2 The Commission must take proposed action before taking final action to approve the cases described in Subtitle Z

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,603  PROPOSED ACTION,603.3, ,sub-sec-16.6.4.3,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5981,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.4.3,False,0,603.3 Notice of the Commission’s decision to take proposed action with respect to an application need not be issued.

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,603  PROPOSED ACTION,603.4, ,sub-sec-16.6.4.4,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5982,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.4.4,False,0,"603.4 A proposed action vote is not required to:
(a) Grant an application not listed in Subtitle Z
(b) Amend the text of Subtitles A, Y, or Z
(c) Amend the text of this title on an emergency basis pursuant to D.C. Official Code § 2-505(b)
column2: or (d) Deny any application or petition."

column1: 16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,603  PROPOSED ACTION,603.5, ,sub-sec-16.6.4.5,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5983,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.4.5,False,0,"603.5 A Commission vote to take any of the actions described in Subtitle Z
§ 603.4 is considered a final action."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,604  FINAL ACTION AND FINAL ORDERS,604.1, ,sub-sec-16.6.5.1,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5985,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.5.1,False,0,"604.1 In a rulemaking case to take final action to amend the text of this title, other than Subtitles A, Y, or Z or the Zoning Map, the Commission may proceed following receipt of the written report of the NCPC or after thirty
(30) days from the date of the referral required under Subtitle Z
§ 603.1(b), whichever is sooner.
In no case shall the Commission take final action sooner than the expiration of the period of public comment stated in the publication of the proposed rulemaking in the D.C. Register."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,604  FINAL ACTION AND FINAL ORDERS,604.2, ,sub-sec-16.6.5.2,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5986,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.5.2,False,0,"604.2 In a contested case, to take final action to approve a map amendment, including an amendment related to a PUD, or an air space development, the Commission may proceed following receipt of the written report of NCPC or after thirty
(30) days from the date of the referral required under Subtitle Z
§ 603.1(b), whichever is sooner."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,604  FINAL ACTION AND FINAL ORDERS,604.3, ,sub-sec-16.6.5.3,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5987,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.5.3,False,0,"604.3 The Commission may proceed without a referral to or report from NCPC to:
(a) Deny any application or petition
column2: or (b) Approve any case for which NCPC referral is not specifically required under Subtitle Z

column1: 16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,604  FINAL ACTION AND FINAL ORDERS,604.4, ,sub-sec-16.6.5.4,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5988,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.5.4,False,0,604.4 The final action of the Commission on an application or petition shall be in the form of a written order that shall be filed in the record.

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,604  FINAL ACTION AND FINAL ORDERS,604.5, ,sub-sec-16.6.5.5,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5989,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.5.5,False,0,"604.5 A copy of the order shall be served on:
(a) The petitioner
(b) The applicant and any other parties, if any

(d) The ANC Commissioner for the Single-Member District within which the property is located, if any
column2: and (e) The Councilmember for the Ward within which the property, if any, is located."

column1: 16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,604  FINAL ACTION AND FINAL ORDERS,604.6, ,sub-sec-16.6.5.6,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5990,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.5.6,False,0,"604.6 In a rulemaking case, orders shall be published in the D.C. Register as a notice of emergency or final rulemaking action, as is applicable."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,604  FINAL ACTION AND FINAL ORDERS,604.7, ,sub-sec-16.6.5.7,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5991,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.5.7,False,0,"604.7 In a contested case, the order shall be accompanied by findings of fact and conclusions of law unless the decision is not adverse to any party, in which case a summary form of order may be used.

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,604  FINAL ACTION AND FINAL ORDERS,604.8, ,sub-sec-16.6.5.8,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5992,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.5.8,False,0,"604.8 In a contested case, unless specifically stated otherwise, the term ""applicant"" in any condition of an order approving an application (including a modification) shall mean the person or entity then holding title to the subject property.
If there is more than one
(1) owner, the obligations under the order shall be joint and several.
If a person or entity no longer holds title to the subject property, that party shall have no further obligations under the order
column2: however, that party remains liable for any violation of any condition that occurred while an owner."

column1: 16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 6 POST-HEARING PROCEDURES,604  FINAL ACTION AND FINAL ORDERS,604.9, ,sub-sec-16.6.5.9,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-5993,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.6.5.9,False,0,604.9 A written order setting forth a final action shall become final and effective upon publication in the D.C. column1: AFTER FINAL ORDER",700.3, ,sub-sec-16.7.1.3,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-6005,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.7.1.3,False,0,"700.3 A motion for reconsideration or rehearing of a final order granting or denying an application may be filed by a party within ten
(10) days of the order having become final and shall meet the following requirements:
(a) The motion shall be served upon all other parties
(b) The Commission shall not receive or consider any motion for reconsideration or rehearing that is filed prior to an order becoming final and effective pursuant to Subtitle Z
§ 604.9, nor shall it waive this prohibition
(c) A request by a non-party for leave to file a request for reconsideration or rehearing shall not be accepted, nor shall such request be waived.
Any such request received shall immediately be returned by Office of Zoning staff
(d) A motion for reconsideration must cite the relevant legal error which the motion asserts was misapplied
column2: and (e) A motion for rehearing must cite newly discovered evidence that existed at the time of the hearing which, by due diligence, could not have been reasonably presented to the Commission at the time of the hearing and impacts the material facts upon which the Commission’s decision was based.

column1: The motion must show good cause for why the newly discovered evidence could not have been reasonably presented at the hearing.
Should the Commission grant the motion for rehearing, it may schedule a limited scope hearing to hear testimony on the newly discovered evidence."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 7 APPROVALS AND ORDERS,701  STAY OF FINAL DECISION AND ORDER,701.1, ,sub-sec-16.7.2.1,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-6016,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.7.2.1,False,0,"701.1 The Commission, on its own motion or the motion of a party or petitioner to the District of Columbia Court of Appeals, may order the effectiveness of a final decision and order of the Commission stayed, pending reconsideration or rehearing, sua sponte review, or appeal of the decision and order to the Court of Appeals."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 7 APPROVALS AND ORDERS,701  STAY OF FINAL DECISION AND ORDER,701.2, ,sub-sec-16.7.2.2,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-6017,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.7.2.2,False,0,"701.2 Except for stays granted upon its own motion, the Commission shall grant a stay only upon finding all four of the following criteria are present:

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 7 APPROVALS AND ORDERS,702  VALIDITY OF APPROVALS AND IMPLEMENTATION,702.14, ,sub-sec-16.7.3.14,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-9347,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.7.3.14,False,0,"702.14 As of October 1, 2021, any condition in an order issued by the Zoning Commission requiring the approval of the Office of the Attorney General shall be understood to refer to the approval of the Office of Zoning Legal Division."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 7 APPROVALS AND ORDERS,702  VALIDITY OF APPROVALS AND IMPLEMENTATION,702.15, ,sub-sec-16.7.3.15,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-9949,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.7.3.15,False,0,"702.15 Zoning Commission orders in contested cases that authorize the construction or alteration of a building or structure shall include the following types of design flexibility from the plans approved by the order unless a condition in the order limits or revises this flexibility.
The flexibility granted in paragraphs (d) through (h) is available only if the plans approved by the order depict the particular features:
(a) Interior Components:

To vary the location and design of all interior components, including partitions, structural slabs, doors, hallways, columns, stairways, atria, and mechanical rooms, provided that the variations do not change the exterior configuration of the building as shown on the plans approved by the order
(b) Exterior Materials – Color:

To vary the final selection of the colors of the exterior materials based on availability at the time of construction, provided such colors are within the color ranges shown on the plans approved by the order
(c) Exterior Details – Location and Dimension:

To make minor refinements to the locations and dimensions of exterior details that do not substantially alter the exterior configuration of the building or design shown on the plans approved by the order.
Examples of exterior details would include, but are not limited to, doorways, canopies, railings, and skylights
(d) Number of Units:

To provide a range in the approved number of residential dwelling units of plus or minus ten percent (10%), except that (1) the total square footage of the residential dwelling units shall not be reduced, and
(2) the number of units and the square footage reserved for affordable housing shall not be reduced
(e) Parking Layout:

To make refinements to the approved parking configuration, including layout and number of parking space plus or minus ten percent (10%), so long as the number of parking spaces is at least the minimum number of spaces required by the Zoning Regulations
(f) Streetscape Design:
To vary the location, attributes, and general design of the approved streetscape to comply with the requirements of, and the approval by, the DDOT Public Space Division
(g) Signage:

To vary the font, message, logo, and color of the approved signage, provided that the maximum overall dimensions and signage materials are consistent with the signage on the plans approved by the order and are compliant with the DC signage regulations
column2: and (h) Sustainable Features:

column1: To vary the approved sustainable features of the project, provided the total number of LEED points achievable for the project does not decrease below the minimum required for the LEED standard specified by the order."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 7 APPROVALS AND ORDERS,703  CONSENT CALENDAR – TECHNICAL CORRECTIONS TO ADOPTED RULES AND MODIFICATIONS WITHOUT HEARINGS TO CONTESTED CASE ORDERS AND PLANS,703.1, ,sub-sec-16.7.4.1,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-6033,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.7.4.1,False,0,"703.1 This procedure shall allow the Commission, in the interest of efficiency, to make, without public hearing, modifications to approved contested case final orders and plans approved by such orders (modifications without hearing) and technical corrections to adopted rules (technical corrections).
The Office of Zoning is authorized to make technical corrections to contested case orders with the permission of the Chair of the Commission."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 7 APPROVALS AND ORDERS,703  CONSENT CALENDAR – TECHNICAL CORRECTIONS TO ADOPTED RULES AND MODIFICATIONS WITHOUT HEARINGS TO CONTESTED CASE ORDERS AND PLANS,703.2, ,sub-sec-16.7.4.2,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-6034,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.7.4.2,False,0,"703.2 For the purposes of this section, “technical correction” means a change to the adopted text, including the addition or deletion of material, that is needed (a) to correct omissions or errors of grammar, spelling, or citation, or (b) to make other non-substantive changes needed to clarify the intent of the Commission when it adopted the text."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 7 APPROVALS AND ORDERS,703  CONSENT CALENDAR – TECHNICAL CORRECTIONS TO ADOPTED RULES AND MODIFICATIONS WITHOUT HEARINGS TO CONTESTED CASE ORDERS AND PLANS,703.4, ,sub-sec-16.7.4.4,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-6036,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.7.4.4,False,0,"703.4 The Commission, upon its own motion, may place a technical correction on the Consent Calendar.
The Office of Planning or Office of Zoning may initiate a request for a technical correction through the filing of a report."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 7 APPROVALS AND ORDERS,703  CONSENT CALENDAR – TECHNICAL CORRECTIONS TO ADOPTED RULES AND MODIFICATIONS WITHOUT HEARINGS TO CONTESTED CASE ORDERS AND PLANS,703.5, ,sub-sec-16.7.4.5,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-6037,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.7.4.5,False,0,"703.5 All other requests for a technical correction shall be served by the person requesting Consent Calendar placement upon the affected ANC, unless that ANC is making the request."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 7 APPROVALS AND ORDERS,703  CONSENT CALENDAR – TECHNICAL CORRECTIONS TO ADOPTED RULES AND MODIFICATIONS WITHOUT HEARINGS TO CONTESTED CASE ORDERS AND PLANS,703.6, ,sub-sec-16.7.4.6,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-6038,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.7.4.6,False,0,"703.6 For the purposes of this section, a “modification without hearing” is a modification in which impact may be understood without witness testimony, including, but not limited to a proposed change to a condition in the final order, a change in position on an issue discussed by the Commission that affected its decision, or a redesign or relocation of architectural elements and open spaces from the final design approved by the Commission.

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 7 APPROVALS AND ORDERS,705  TIME EXTENSIONS,705.1, ,sub-sec-16.7.6.1,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-6058,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.7.6.1,False,0,705.1 The provisions of this section apply in their entirety to applications for design review and planned unit developments (PUDs) approved by the Zoning Commission.

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 7 APPROVALS AND ORDERS,705  TIME EXTENSIONS,705.2, ,sub-sec-16.7.6.2,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-6059,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.7.6.2,False,0,"705.2 An applicant may request an extension of the time periods of an order for good cause upon the filing of a written request, before the expiration of the approval, documenting the following:
(a) The extension request is served on all parties to the application by the applicant, and all parties are allowed thirty
(30) days to respond

(b) There is no substantial change in any of the material facts upon which the Commission based its original approval of the application that would undermine the Commission’s justification for approving the original application
column2: and (c) The applicant demonstrates with substantial evidence one

column1: (1) or more of the following criteria:

(1) An inability to obtain sufficient project financing for the development, following an applicant’s diligent good faith efforts to obtain such financing, because of changes in economic and market conditions beyond the applicant’s reasonable control

(2) An inability to secure all required governmental agency approvals for a development by the expiration date of the order because of delays in the governmental agency approval process that are beyond the applicant’s reasonable control
column2: or (3) The existence of pending litigation or such other condition, circumstance, or factor beyond the applicant’s reasonable control that renders the applicant unable to comply with the time limits of the order."

column1: 16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 8 SUA SPONTE REVIEW,800  SUA SPONTE REVIEW BY ZONING COMMISSION,800.6, ,sub-sec-16.8.1.6,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-6077,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.8.1.6,False,0,800.6 The sua sponte review process established in this section shall not grant any rights of appeal to the Commission.

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 8 SUA SPONTE REVIEW,800  SUA SPONTE REVIEW BY ZONING COMMISSION,800.7, ,sub-sec-16.8.1.7,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-6078,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.8.1.7,False,0,"800.7 Because there is no right of appeal to the Commission from any action of the Board of Zoning Adjustment, the Commission need not answer any communications to the Commission (regardless of the form) requesting that sua sponte review be undertaken.
Sua sponte review is a discretionary internal process."

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 8 SUA SPONTE REVIEW,800  SUA SPONTE REVIEW BY ZONING COMMISSION,800.8, ,sub-sec-16.8.1.8,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-6079,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.8.1.8,False,0,"800.8 The Commission shall look to the following guidelines when determining whether to invoke its sua sponte review authority.
The Commission may exercise sua sponte review as follows:
(a) In a particular instance where it appears to the Commission that the Board of Zoning Adjustment has exceeded its authority and has thus in effect changed the zoning
(b) Where it appears that a basic policy of the Commission, as expressed in the Zoning Regulations, has been violated as a result of action by the Board of Zoning Adjustment
column2: or (c) In an unusual instance, as determined by the Commission."

column1: 16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 9 REMAND PROCEDURE,900  INTRODUCTION TO THE REMAND PROCESS,900.1, ,sub-sec-16.9.1.1,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-6082,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.9.1.1,False,0,900.1 This chapter provides regulations for Commission to follow when the District of Columbia Court of Appeals remands a Commission decision for further proceedings.

16,SUBTITLE Z ZONING COMMISSION RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE,CHAPTER 9 REMAND PROCEDURE,901  REMAND PROCEDURES,901.1, ,sub-sec-16.9.2.1,https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/washington-dc/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=5609#secid-6084,https://zoneomics.com/code/191/chapter_16#16.9.2.1,False,0,"901.1 Upon receipt of a Court of Appeals mandate remanding a Commission decision, the Director shall request the Office of Zoning Legal

column2: and (c) Provides such further information and analysis as to enable the Commission to comply with the remand instructions."
